title: Quiet tools
description: Tools should make attention easier to keep, not compete for it.
content: A good tool disappears into the rhythm of work. Its strongest feature may be the absence of interruption.

title: Maps are questions
description: A semantic map is useful when it helps us ask what belongs together.
content: Coordinates are not the meaning of a collection. They are a prompt to look again, compare distant ideas, and make a new connection.
